metadata.title: प्यासा आदिवासी भारत | Drinking Water Problems of Tribal India | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: Launched in 2019, the Jal Jeevan Mission promised tap water for every rural household by 2024. But in the heart of Tribal India, the ground reality tells a different story. Despite the tall claims and allocated funds, many tribal villages across states still struggle to access clean and safe drinking water. Our team at Main Bhi Bharat travels to remote tribal regions to uncover the gaps between policy and practice. From broken pipelines to contaminated sources, this report brings you voices from the ground that continue to wait for what was promised.
